pr_title: fix(role): explicitly hidden aria-labelledby should be recursively traversed
pr_body:
The accessible name computation spec has changed to explicitly mention this case:

Step 2A. Hidden Not Referenced. If the current node is hidden and is:
- Not part of an aria-labelledby or aria-describedby traversal, where the node directly referenced by that relation was hidden.
- Nor part of a native host language text alternative element (e.g. label in HTML) or attribute traversal, where the root of that traversal was hidden.

See https://w3c.github.io/accname/#computation-steps. Chromium, Firefox and Safari all agree with the spec.

Fixes #29796.

issue_context.title: [Bug]: `getByRole` unable to find button with accessible name.
issue_context.body:
### Version

1.42.1

### Steps to reproduce

`getByRole('button', { name: "Name of my button" })` fails to find my button which has an accessible name.

Specifically, my button has an `aria-labelledby`, and receives its accessible name from a custom tooltip element.

1. Clone my repo at: https://github.com/khiga8/playwright-get-by-role-bug
2. Run `npm install` and `npx install playwright`
3. Run `npm run test` and see test failure.

Chrome's accessibility inspector also identifies this button's accessible name:


![Screenshot of accessibility inspector in Chrome which shows "Button" as the name for the icon button, derived from the tooltip](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/assets/16447748/c1eb2dda-97c6-473a-a9e6-7f86ce483143)


### Expected behavior

I expect to see Playwright locate my button because it has an `aria-labelledby` that points to an existing element.

### Actual behavior

Playwright is unable to locate my button and times out.

### Additional context

_No response_
